label: 移動
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR-frame in-place HOVER movement of 魔神 EXACT 2x2. Body root y=550,535,550,565, torso leans left 10 degrees, wing tips beat up/neutral/down/neutral by 35px. Hair/cape follows 15px right. Smooth 4->1. Halo floats, all SIX arms move only subtly 10px, no wings added. Match the FIRST fixed canonical reference identity, palette, proportions, face, armor, weapons, wing/tail attachments and refined JRPG pixel art: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped edges, dark outline, no airbrush or 3D render. LEFT-facing mild 3/4 view. All complete silhouettes have 12% clear margin in their own equal cells; no clipped tails, blades, wings, horns, fingers or feet. Same scale across every frame, true transparent alpha. No background, floor slab, shadow plate, labels, grid, checkerboard, text, watermark, extra creatures or detached body parts. Female characters remain clearly adults, dressed/armored as reference. EXACTLY SIX arms in three pairs, each with its own shoulder, upper arm, elbow, forearm, wrist and hand. Preserve frontal readable arm spread and rotate gaze/torso only slightly LEFT 15 degrees; never hide an entire arm. Original dark halo and two legs.  Each cell local 0..1024. Body root (540,550), head around (330,350) for bipeds or (300,520) for quadrupeds. Ground contacts y=850. Whole silhouette in x=100..920,y=120..880. Coordinates are movement targets, not evidence of output compliance.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending
